Trend test across all sampling dates. Blue: neutral-simulation threshold, mean realised rate of 20 thresholds, each set by SPOT from its own neutral simulations
(2,000 by default; c: up to 200,000), applied to 100,000 (c: 100,000 or 1,000,000) independent neutral simulations. Red: sampling-only threshold.
Reference design: haplodiploid, 1935/1955/1975/2025, 20/20/20/40 females, 10×/15× depth, p₀ = 0.1. a: Ne varied in each inheritance system. b: one factor changed at a time.
